summary.headline: Solar Significations and Planetary Aspects
summary.text: Astrological significations of Mars opposite the Moon and of the Sun, including bodily parts, substances, fruits, rulers, patronage, public reputation, and effects of conjunctions with Venus and Mercury. Sun–Moon trines and squares, especially in the angles and under Jupiter or malefics, are interpreted through Valens and other star testimonies.
